import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int totalItems = scanner.nextInt();
        int maxBudget = scanner.nextInt();
        int[] numbers = new int[totalItems];
        for (int index = 0; index < totalItems; index++) {
            numbers[index] = scanner.nextInt();
        }
        System.out.println(calculateMaxCuts(numbers, maxBudget));
    }

    private static int calculateMaxCuts(int[] array, int budget) {
        ArrayList<Integer> differences = new ArrayList<>();
        int evenCount = array[0] % 2 == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        int oddCount = array[0] % 2 == 1 ? 1 : 0;
        int cutsMade = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < array.length; i++) {
            if (oddCount == evenCount && Math.abs(array[i] - array[i - 1]) <= budget) {
                evenCount = 0;
                oddCount = 0;
                differences.add(Math.abs(array[i] - array[i - 1]));
            }
            if (array[i] % 2 == 0) {
                evenCount++;
            } else {
                oddCount++;
            }
        }
        Collections.sort(differences);
        for (int diff : differences) {
            if (budget < diff) {
                break;
            }
            cutsMade++;
            budget -= diff;
        }
        return cutsMade;
    }
}
